title: MANGO-Grasp: Mahalanobis Fields over Geometry-Oriented 3D Gaussians for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping
abstract: arXiv:2608.02014v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cross-embodiment dexterous grasping aims to synthesize stable grasps across heterogeneous multi-fingered hands with little or no embodiment-specific tuning. Existing interaction-centric methods achieve promising results, but their object representations often underrepresent local surface geometry, hand descriptors do not explicitly capture both morphology and kinematics, and hand-object interaction modeling is typically isotropic. We propose MANGO-Grasp, an anisotropic interaction framework that represents objects as geometry-oriented 3D Gaussian primitives to better preserve local surface geometry, and encodes hands into pretrained descriptors that capture both morphology and kinematics. Hand-object interaction is modeled using anisotropic Mahalanobis fields that reflect the directional nature of contact and guide a shared optimization for grasp realization across embodiments. On the CMAP and MultiGripperGrasp benchmarks, MANG

translated_title: MANGO-Grasp：基于几何导向3D高斯的马氏距离场实现跨具身灵巧抓取
translated_abstract: 跨具身灵巧抓取旨在异构的多指灵巧手之间合成稳定的抓取，而几乎不需要或完全不需要针对特定具身形态的调优。现有的以交互为中心的方法取得了可观的效果，但其物体表示往往无法充分表达局部表面几何，手部描述符未能显式地同时捕捉形态学与运动学特性，且手-物体交互建模通常是各向同性的。我们提出MANGO-Grasp，这是一个各向异性交互框架：它将物体表示为几何导向的3D高斯基元，以更好地保留局部表面几何；并将手部编码为能够同时捕捉形态与运动学的预训练描述符。手-物体交互通过各向异性马氏距离场进行建模，该场反映了接触的方向性本质，并引导一种跨具身形态的共享优化以实现抓取。在CMAP和MultiGripperGrasp基准测试中，MANGO-Grasp……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MANGO-Grasp框架，利用几何导向的3D高斯表示物体、预训练描述符编码手部，并通过各向异性马氏距离场建模手-物体交互，从而在无需针对特定具身形态调优的情况下，实现跨异构多指灵巧手的稳定灵巧抓取。
